user.title: Thread Border Router
user.description: Adds sensors for Thread border routers found through the Matter integration.

abort.matter_not_loaded: The Matter integration is not loaded. Set up Matter first.

create_network.name: Create Thread network
create_network.description: Creates a new Thread network on the border router and saves its credentials in Home Assistant. A border router can only hold one network and Matter has no command to delete it, so this fails if one already exists.

network_name.name: Network name
network_name.description: 1 to 16 bytes. A random name is used if empty.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Thread channel 11 to 26. If empty, one is chosen automatically to avoid known Wi-Fi and Zigbee channels (25 when nothing is known).

passphrase.name: Passphrase
passphrase.description: Commissioner passphrase, 6 to 255 bytes. Only needed for external Thread commissioners; it is not stored. A random PSKc is used if empty.

sync_network.name: Save network credentials
sync_network.description: Reads the credentials of the network that already exists on the border router and saves them in Home Assistant and matter-server. Use it when a network was created but its credentials were not saved.

change_channel.name: Change Thread channel
change_channel.description: Moves the existing Thread network to another channel without recreating it. After the delay, every device on the network switches at the same time. Only works while the border router is the network leader.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Thread channel 11 to 26. If empty, one is chosen automatically to avoid known Wi-Fi and Zigbee channels.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait before the network switches, 30 to 600. Gives sleepy devices time to learn about the change.

adopt_network.name: Adopt Thread network
adopt_network.description: Makes a border router join an existing Thread network, so two border routers share one network. Uses the preferred Thread network of Home Assistant unless a source border router is chosen. If the border router is already on a different network, that whole network, including every device on it, is migrated to the target network after the delay; this cannot be cancelled and needs the border router to be the leader.

source_device.name: Source border router
source_device.description: Another border router whose current network is adopted. If empty, the preferred Thread network of Home Assistant is used.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Only used when the border router is already on another network: seconds to wait before the network switches, 30 to 600.

init.title: Channel selection
init.description: When a network is created without a channel, the channel is chosen to avoid interference. The Zigbee channel is read from ZHA automatically; add whatever else you know about here.

data_description.wifi_channels: Channels used by Wi-Fi access points nearby. Thread channels under them are avoided.
